message.content:
## Recent developments
* **CEO Transition and Resignation:** Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of NVIDIA following an investigation initiated by the company's Board of Directors regarding personal conduct and relationships ([NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition), [The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/08/technology/nvidia-investigation-jensen-huang-china.html)).
* **Interim Leadership:** Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, has been appointed interim CEO while the board conducts a search for a permanent replacement. Additionally, Harvey C. Jones was appointed the first-ever Chair of the Board ([NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)).
* **Strategic Partnerships:** Despite executive changes, NVIDIA recently announced a collaboration with Rebellions and SK Telecom to advance sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ([NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)).

## Talking points
* How the interim leadership under Colette Kress plans to maintain operational continuity during the search for a permanent CEO.
* The current status and findings of the independent board investigations and any potential impact on enterprise governance.
* Progress on core product pipelines, strategic partnerships (such as SK Telecom and Rebellions), and upcoming financial result calls.

## Open questions
* What is the expected timeline for identifying and appointing a permanent CEO?
* Are there any broader compliance or security implications stemming from the board's investigations that could impact major enterprise or governmental contracts?
* How will NVIDIA reassure key partners and stakeholders regarding its ongoing technology roadmap and market dominance in accelerated computing?

## Sources
* [NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition - NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
* [Nvidia scandal: What’s next for the US tech company? - Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/13/nvidia-scandal-whats-next-for-the-us-tech-company)
* [Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors - NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
* [Nvidia Opens Investigation Into Jensen Huang’s Relationship With Suspected Chinese Spy - The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/08/technology/nvidia-investigation-jensen-huang-china.html)
* [Timeline of the stunning fall of powerful Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang - ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Business/timeline-stunning-fall-powerful-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang/story?id=138041659)
